title: Scope Courtesy on ClearPath After-Hours Remote Labor
content:
The scope courtesy on the after-hours remote amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket reads the ticket's scope determination and issue category, both as recorded when the ticket was opened.

| Scope determination | Issue category | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| covered | outage, degraded service or security concern | 15.0 percent off |
| covered | any other category | 5.0 percent off |
| billable out of scope | any | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases.** A covered ticket opened as a security concern and worked remotely on a Saturday night takes 15.0 percent off; a covered ticket opened as a how-to question takes 5.0 percent off; a ticket determined billable out of scope at opening takes nothing off whatever its category.
